readiness_blockers.evidence: run_replications.py builds a fixed seed ledger from num_replicates and iterates every ledger row; it does not dynamically continue until 24 valid blocks or stop on the 24th valid block.
readiness_blockers.required_before_formal_launch: A frozen formal runner contract must specify and implement valid-block stopping/replacement behavior without allowing >24 valid blocks into analysis.

readiness_blockers.evidence: run_replications.py does not have a formal-mode guard that rejects or prevents requests capable of producing more than 24 valid formal blocks.
readiness_blockers.required_before_formal_launch: Formal launch tooling must prevent overcomplete formal batches or prove exact stop at 24 valid blocks.

audit_notes: Analysis layer now treats valid<24 as incomplete, valid==24 as exact_complete, and valid>24 as overcomplete.
Failed, invalid, interrupted, and engineering P001-P005 blocks remain excluded from formal valid block counts.
No real LLM call or formal sample launch was performed during this readiness audit.
